key_difference: On EBUSY, (B) simply closes the fd and retries unlink(), but (D) adds a rename-aside / dev+ino-check / rename-back scheme exposed as new private (autotest-exported) API. That scheme relies on QFileSystemEngine::renameFile's link+unlink fallback on NFS, which the reviewer flagged. It also briefly moves another process's live lock away, so a third process can create a new lock in that window, breaking mutual exclusion, and a failed restore leaves an orphaned lock. (D) also handles only EBUSY, not ETXTBSY/EPERM.
